name: request-response-longfast
description: Shallow-windowed RPC through a shaped pipe at Meshtastic LongFast timings (~1,070 bps airtime, ~175 ms preamble latency): command-and-telemetry exchanges on the wire mesh radios actually have. A 40-byte request and its 200-byte response cost ~2 seconds of channel time between them, so requests per minute and the protocol's byte tax are the products - window 2, because a real LoRa channel cannot pipeline deep without starving its own ACKs.
conformance: sent == delivered + timeouts with zero timeouts expected - the pipe delays, it never drops, so any timeout is a deadline mis-sized for the wire
